dedupe_keys.name: national road network nrn geobase series canada

description: The National Road Network (NRN) is the GeoBase series dataset giving a consistent geometric and attribute description of the roads of Canada, now published by Statistics Canada on the Open Government Portal. It is delivered as 13 provincial and territorial datasets. Its line entities are Road Segments and Ferry Connection Segments, and its point entities are Junctions, Blocked Passages and Toll Points; attributes include address ranges and house numbers, street names, functional road class, pavement status, number of lanes, structure type (such as bridges and tunnels), route numbers and names, and exit numbers. Coverage is national. The NRN edition 2.0 model was adopted in 2005 by the Inter-Agency Committee on Geomatics and the Canadian Council on Geomatics and conforms largely to the ISO 14825 road network standard. The data are available to download as GeoPackage, shapefile and ZIP packages, and as ESRI REST and WMS services, free under the Open Government Licence - Canada (portal record modified December 2024). Caveats: it is delivered as separate provincial and territorial datasets, and copies of individual provincial layers circulate on ArcGIS Online with their own owners. The network gives the road topology, lane counts and bridge and tunnel structures needed for network flow, criticality and hazard exposure analysis of Canadian roads. It complements the National Railway Network (NRWN) and the Statistics Canada Road Network File, and is related to OpenStreetMap.
